description:
Recent platform changes, newest first.

platform: filter by platform (apple, android, google-play, github, vercel, cloudflare, expo, supabase, firebase).
tag: filter by heuristic tag (deprecation, breaking, deadline, policy, security, pricing).
days: look-back window (max 90). limit: max items (max 50). Summaries are truncated; use get_change for full text.
min_importance: "low" (everything), "medium" or "high" to drop routine release noise. Importance is AI-rated or heuristic (see importance_basis).
by: "published" (default) or "updated", which also surfaces old posts the vendor edited recently.
name: recent_changes
